heading: Reconnect split panes and set agent download limits
summary: Reconnecting a split SFTP pane keeps the tab, and agent download limits are now settings.
changes: Reconnecting a split remote pane no longer hides the tab or its files.
Set the largest file and the number of staged files per bookmark in Settings → Agents.
The agent skill now has agents inspect files over SSH before downloading them.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
